# Design scalable context retrieval and semantic routing for DIP

User proposes extending DIP beyond small-project Markdown comparisons to huge repositories with hundreds/thousands of documents. Current compactContext/task_next are bounded generic lists, not query-relevant retrieval. Proposed direction: canonical structured intent/events in .dip, derived local incremental lexical/vector indexes, graph/current-revision/status/scope filters, budgeted source-linked context packets per user intent, and semantic candidate triggers reviewed by the existing working agent. TurboVec is a candidate optional local vector backend (Rust/Python); it does not generate embeddings or determine authoritative project state. No engine installed and no semantic product feature implemented in this exploratory turn. Preserve zero model calls on routine capture; embedding work is explicit, asynchronous and optional rather than an extra chat model per tracking action.

## Current criteria
- Retrieve current relevant requirements, decisions, dependencies, ownership and evidence within a fixed context budget, with source IDs and freshness reasons; do not select cancelled/superseded intent as authoritative due to semantic similarity.
- Keep tracked .dip events canonical and indexes rebuildable/local; index only changed content and apply explicit invalidation/deletion on revisions, merges and cancellations.
- Use a provider interface so lexical fallback works without embeddings/extra runtimes; evaluate TurboVec integration/platform/setup costs before choosing a mandatory backend.
- Benchmark instructed Markdown search, structured lexical DIP and hybrid semantic DIP across increasing corpora with obsolete/conflicting documents. Measure relevant-current recall, stale-rule mistakes, final task correctness, tokens, latency and index maintenance cost; do not presume vectors improve quality.
- Use semantic matches as candidates for links/conflicts/duplicate intent; require explicit agent mutation and real configured verification for state changes or verified completion.

# Evaluate Laya and compact multilingual pair classifiers for existing-task matching

User asks whether Laya or a specialized micro dense model can detect existing open/completed tasks despite paraphrasing. Proposed experiment related to scalable retrieval task task_76b337bcfa7db953636318fb7dd755799ae72c04cfc7c53fc29c5cbf60b5b4df: retrieve candidate tasks using lexical/vector/metadata search, then compare a request/task pair using Laya multilingual and a compact pretrained multilingual encoder with a trained classification head. Laya is a candidate decision model, not yet validated on DIP; primary model card warns about zero-shot/domain calibration and overconfidence, and multilingual checkpoint has 322M parameters. Prefer baseline evaluation and fine-tuning/distillation of pretrained encoders over training language capabilities from scratch. Models propose same/partial/related/different links; open/completed status and verification remain authoritative structured state/current code evidence. No model installed, trained or called in this exploratory turn.

## Current criteria
- Build independently reviewed positive, partial-overlap, related-only and hard-negative request/task pairs, including Hebrew-English paraphrases, negation, changed scope/version and different components; split held-out evaluation by project and time to avoid paraphrase leakage.
- Compare lexical/embedding candidate retrieval, compact cross-encoder pair classification and Laya on the same inputs. Measure candidate recall, false duplicate links, missed duplicates, partial completion coverage, confidence calibration/abstention, CPU latency, RAM and installation overhead.
- Fine-tune or distill only after labeled evaluation shows where existing candidates fail; do not assert that a particular micro-model size or training-set size guarantees quality.
- Keep routine Git capture model-free; semantic inference runs at meaningful user-intent or completion milestones. Require agent review of uncertain links, and configured real-code checks for verified completion.

# Compare open-source alternatives to Laya for DIP task matching

Compare open-source task-retrieval and relationship models against the preserved Laya pilot. Expanded at user's request: train/distill a specialized non-generative dense or static relation encoder with target budgets near 10M and 100M total parameters, and tokenizer-vocabulary ablations including 100k/200k tokens where feasible. Use user request Q and assistant response/plan A as separate evidence channels: test Q only, A only, Q+A concatenation and a predeclared fusion. Benchmark retrieval across large Markdown and structured DIP stores, not only classification of one supplied pair. Research shortlist includes Model2Vec/Potion (7.6M/32.3M English and128.1M multilingual), multilingual E5-small and MiniLM-L12 (~117.7M, Hebrew listed), small English BGE/MiniLM controls, and larger GTE/Qwen/BGE reranker references. The bounded pretrained stage task_358d32ed-9c7b-453e-a23f-244f00ef174c evaluated seven pinned alternatives plus BM25 on new family-separated synthetic retrieval/pair cases. Multilingual MiniLM raw top10 44/48, E5 43/48, Potion multilingual37/48 versus BM25 24/48 at10k; this is not autonomous identity or real-agent quality. Custom training, larger references, independent labels and downstream evaluation remain unperformed. Licensed source/weight review and independent held-out evaluation required.

## Current criteria
- Verify code and weight licenses, pinned revisions, local CPU/platform runtime and actual total parameter/embedding-table budgets for every candidate; broader token vocabularies are not language knowledge and consume V*d parameters in an ordinary table.
- Include custom 10M/100M dense/static retrieval training or distillation as explicit candidates; compare against pretrained baselines before claiming training from scratch is easy or necessary. Report data, compute, training and inference costs.
- Evaluate Q-only, A-only, Q+A and predeclared fusion using the same historical tasks. Generate assistant text before retrieval; exclude leaked task IDs/answers, and include incorrect or scope-expanding replies. User intent remains authoritative.
- Use fair factorial baselines: Markdown with rg/BM25 without DIP/neural model; Markdown with the same neural retriever; structured DIP lexical only; structured DIP with neural/hybrid retrieval. Scale to 100/1000/10000 historical items with superseded/cancelled/open/completed tasks and version/scope confounders.
- Measure Recall@1/5/10, MRR, false exact merges, stale/cancelled-rule errors, no-match abstention, downstream correctness, tokens, cold/warm CPU latency, RAM and indexing updates. Similarity/reranking scores are not completion evidence.
- Split reviewed training/calibration/test examples by project, time and task family; do not mix paraphrase variants or use the already-published Laya pilot as both tuning and final-test data.
- Keep alternatives and custom training unfinished until actually evaluated; retain all outcomes and use real code evidence for task completion.

# DIP-B02: Evaluate worktree-aware scope coordination and merge-aware handoffs

The longitudinal controlled experiment observed actual shared-file ownership refusals across isolated worktrees (7 captured hook denial records and 10 denied MCP claim replies). All 4 DIP projects still encountered a pipeline.mjs merge conflict, as did all 4 controls. Workers deliberately forked the same base and were committed only after both finished; waiting could not update the other worker's branch in this schedule. Final quality remained identical (120/120 primary, 52/52 exact intent, 9216/9216 exploratory stress per arm). This is a local scheduling/merge-handoff limitation to investigate, not evidence that all scope locking is ineffective or that conflicts imply lost code.

## Current criteria
- Profile actual contention, waiting and repeated model/tool loops using the published raw traces before changing scope policy.
- Evaluate how to allow legitimate edits in isolated worktrees while preserving same-worktree fencing and ownership of the same logical task; make branch/base freshness visible.
- Test merge-aware handoffs under induced overlap and report code preservation, coordination cost and remaining Git conflicts without promising automatic conflict-free integration.

# DIP-L05: Design opt-in coordination across independent clones and machines

Scope boundary. QA baseline: DIP v0.3.2, 6 October 2026.

Live claims are local to a shared Git worktree family. Independent clones and computers merge durable intent through Git but do not share live leases. Push/merge alone cannot prevent simultaneous execution or guarantee exclusivity.

Evidence and starting points: docs/compatibility.md, docs/automation.md, README.md.

This is unassigned contributor backlog, not implemented work. Preserve the existing license, DCO and local/offline defaults.

## Current criteria
- Document an opt-in shared coordinator and stable project identity while preserving the default offline/local workflow.
- Two independent clones claiming overlapping scope have exactly one winner under the selected coordination mode.
- Test expiry, fencing, partitions, recovery and explicit offline behavior; never imply global ownership from local ASSIGNED state.
- Keep shared data minimal and preserve zero additional capture model calls; disclose network requirements for the optional mode.

# Handle queued activity for vanished temporary repositories without permanent global health noise

Observed during 7 October live-host QA: recorder and supervisor remain running, but doctor repeatedly reports ENOENT for temporary npm/package QA Git roots after they were removed. Restart did not clear the warnings. Root cause and outbox ownership need inspection; do not discard captured data. Package smoke environment also needs auditing for inherited machine Git trace capture.

## Current criteria
- Preserve durable pending activity for missing roots with explicit recoverable state and bounded retry.
- A missing temporary root does not indefinitely imply failure of otherwise healthy project capture.
- Isolated QA subprocesses do not leak native Git trace capture into the real machine recorder.
- Configured tests cover disappearance, return of a repository, restart and continued healthy-project capture.

# Keep partial check success separate from explicit task completion

The frozen 0.3.11 model experiment observed a passing normalization-only check marking the whole jobs requirement verified while scheduling remained unfinished. Record current check evidence without closing work; require explicit implemented finish and prevent finish while structured plan steps remain outstanding. Legacy statuses are not silently migrated.

## Current criteria
- A passing stage check leaves backlog/in-progress intent open with current evidence and retained ownership.
- Explicit task_finish implemented runs configured checks, records verified completion and releases ownership only after success.
- Outstanding structured plan steps reject an implemented finish before semantic mutation; progress completion alone does not finish work.
- Meaningful CLI/MCP and dependency regression checks pass; historical benchmark remains frozen on 0.3.11.
- Explicit bounded structured task_plan fallback works through CLI/MCP and actual authenticated Codex without claiming future work; it is distinguished from unavailable native update_plan.

# DIP-L08: Validate large-ledger performance and reduce measured capture overhead

Measured cost and scale gap. QA baseline: DIP v0.3.2, 6 October 2026.

The v0.3.2 fallback benchmark measured 150.88 ms paired added blocking median on one Windows machine. It is not a latency guarantee; cold/warm, daemon-backed and large-ledger performance have not been comprehensively characterized.

Evidence and starting points: docs/benchmarks/README.md, src/core.js, src/automation.js.

This is unassigned contributor backlog, not implemented work. Preserve the existing license, DCO and local/offline defaults.

## Current criteria
- Publish p50/p95 and memory/event-volume measurements for cold, warm, batched and immediate-fallback paths with explicit sample sizes.
- Use bounded synthetic ledgers at multiple sizes and declare budgets before optimizing; report setup and projection costs separately.
- Reduce demonstrated bottlenecks while preserving durable capture, retries, causal merges, corruption detection and branch isolation.
- Keep default agent context bounded and add no model or remote API dependency to routine recording.

# Build bounded structured navigation and indexed task/decision search

Add read-only tools for authoritative task requirements, live component ownership, changes since evidence and related task/decision retrieval. Use a derived incremental local search index and bounded results with explicit provenance and no automatic identity/completion decisions. Confirm model-comparison investigation remains open and link its published Markdown test design.

## Current criteria
- Tools distinguish current requirements, document freshness, competing intent and verified prerequisites without asserting completion from plans.
- Ownership includes live local worktree leases and overlapping scopes, never expired owners or implied cross-machine locks.
- Changes identify added/modified/deleted scoped and linked source files, intent/check configuration changes and evidence freshness without full histories or secret content.
- Indexed lexical and graph search supports Unicode, status/scope filters, paginated bounded hits and deterministic ordering; index rebuilds from Git-backed intent after loss or change.
- Existing model alternatives task is open with its test-design document linked, without declaring candidates evaluated or trained.

queries.q: Reduce the size of preparation and adoption tool responses and measure schema overhead.
צמצם את הפלט של כלי ההכנה ואימוץ המשימות ומדוד את עלות סכמות הכלים.
Check trusted plan capture, interruption and context compression in real coding hosts.
בדוק קליטת תכניות, הפסקת עבודה ודחיסת הקשר בחיבור חי לסוכני פיתוח.
Design scalable meaning-based routing across a large project history.
תכנן התמצאות לפי משמעות כשהיסטוריית הפרויקט גדולה מאוד.
Evaluate Laya pair classification in Hebrew and English before merging duplicate tasks.
בחן את סיווג זוגות המשימות של Laya בעברית ובאנגלית לפני איחוד כפילויות.
Compare permissive pretrained alternatives and custom tiny encoders for matching tasks.
השווה חלופות קוד פתוח ומודלי אחזור קטנים מותאמים למציאת משימות קיימות.
Improve separate-worktree handoffs so waiting agents refresh their merge base.
שפר העברת עבודה בין עצי עבודה כך שסוכן שהמתין ירענן את בסיס המיזוג.
Coordinate ownership across independent clones on different machines, including offline cases.
תאם בעלות בין עותקים עצמאיים במחשבים שונים, גם כשחיבור הרשת נפסק.
Measure long-term coding quality in natural project changes across multiple domains.
מדוד איכות פיתוח לאורך זמן מול שינויים טבעיים בפרויקטים מתחומים שונים.
Preserve queued recordings for deleted temporary repositories and avoid endless retry errors.
שמור אירועים בתור של תיקיות זמניות שנמחקו והפסק שגיאות חוזרות ללא סוף.
Keep work open when a partial test passes; require explicit full completion.
השאר עבודה פתוחה כשבדיקה חלקית עברה ודרוש סיום מפורש של כל הדרישות.
Profile cold and warm navigation over ten thousand ledger items and reduce capture cost.
מדוד התמצאות קרה וחמה בעשרת אלפים רשומות והפחת את עלות התיעוד.
Link a Markdown plan once using path, role and content hash, then retrieve relevant sections.
קשר תכנית Markdown פעם אחת לפי נתיב, תפקיד וגיבוב תוכן, ואז אחזר סעיפים רלוונטיים.
Expose current criteria, component owners and changes since evidence through focused tools.
הצג דרך כלים ממוקדים דרישות תקפות, בעלי רכיבים ושינויים מאז ראיות הבדיקה.
Make the dashboard readable and minimal with translucent glass and accessible keyboard behavior.
עצב דאשבורד קריא ומינימליסטי עם זכוכית שקופה חלקית ונגישות למקלדת.
Audit unfinished requirements and add explicit outcomes while filtering discussion noise.
בדוק דרישות שנותרו פתוחות והוסף תוצאות מפורשות תוך סינון רעש משיחות.
Recover the completed seven-model retrieval pilot with its frozen raw scores and costs.
מצא את ניסוי האחזור שהושלם על שבע חלופות, עם תוצאות גולמיות ועלויות שנשמרו.
How does search differ from proving that two tasks are equivalent?
כיצד החיפוש שונה מהוכחה ששתי משימות הן אותה משימה?
Where is component ownership read from and does it synchronize between independent machines?
מאיפה נקראת בעלות על רכיב והאם היא מסתנכרנת בין מחשבים עצמאיים?
What happens to queued activity when a repository folder disappears?
